plot-title: The mechanism measures over 14 prompts and 3 models
plot-caption: Each panel gives 1 measure of the F10.24 table for each prompt (rows) and model (columns: G Gemma-4-31B, Q9 Qwen3.5-9B, Q27 Qwen3.6-27B). The gain is the largest out-of-fold R2 that the residual of a token adds to the mean patch, over the saved layers. Mid depth is the saved layer nearest to relative depth 0.5. Values are in t2_grid.csv.
